meta.note: Mirrors web/src/styles/tokens.css, which is the source. web/build/brandTokens.test.ts fails when the two disagree.

tokens.name: pt-bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the backdrop; the halo colour for text set straight on the backdrop.

tokens.name: pt-surface
tokens.usage: Widgets, dialogs, settings cards and inputs. Widgets show it as glass at pt-widget-opacity over the backdrop.

tokens.name: pt-surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary fills: secondary buttons, segmented-control tracks, read-only inputs, tab lists.

tokens.name: pt-surface-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary fills: skeletons, pressed tracks, nested panels.

tokens.name: pt-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised elements on a surface: the selected segment, switch thumbs.

tokens.name: pt-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on pt-surface and pt-surface-2 (about 15:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: pt-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and timestamps on pt-surface and pt-surface-2 (5.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: pt-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary hints only. Below 4.5:1 on pt-surface in both themes (about 3.6:1 light, 4.2:1 dark): never for text people must read.

tokens.name: pt-border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative: never the only thing marking a control.

tokens.name: pt-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: pt-accent
tokens.usage: The user-themable accent (Tide by default): primary buttons, checked controls, the input focus border. White on Tide is about 5:1.

tokens.name: pt-accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pt-accent.

tokens.name: pt-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error text, invalid input borders, always with words or an icon. Error text sits on pt-surface (4.8:1 light); on pt-surface-2 it is 4.4:1 in light.

tokens.name: pt-warning
tokens.usage: Warning banners and badges, with an icon.

tokens.name: pt-success
tokens.usage: Success banners and badges, with an icon.

tokens.name: pt-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline (2px, 2px offset) on every interactive element.

tokens.name: pt-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on ghost buttons, rows and menu items.

tokens.name: pt-active
tokens.usage: Pressed wash on ghost buttons and rows.

tokens.name: pt-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs.

tokens.name: pt-glass-border
tokens.usage: Edge of glass surfaces (widgets, header chips) over the backdrop.

tokens.name: brand-harbor
tokens.usage: Harbor. The icon tile, the wordmark on light grounds, the default backdrop's start.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep. Dark brand grounds and the default backdrop's end.

tokens.name: brand-tide
tokens.usage: Tide. The rock and sea in the icon; the app's default accent.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Sky. The sea line, the porthole glass, light accents on Harbor and Deep.

tokens.name: brand-brass
tokens.usage: Brass. Lighthouse bands, roof, porthole ring. A fill only, never a text colour.

tokens.name: brand-sun
tokens.usage: Sun. The lantern and beams. A fill only, never a text colour.

tokens.name: brand-foam
tokens.usage: Foam. Light brand grounds (banners, the site, docs).

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "SF Mono", "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, outside the app only (site, banners, docs). Harbor on light, white or Foam on dark.

styles.name: brand-headline
styles.sample: Your home port on the web
styles.usage: Headlines on the site and brand pages.

styles.name: brand-subhead
styles.sample: Calendar, mail and tasks in one tab
styles.usage: Subheads on the site and brand pages.

styles.name: text-md
styles.usage: Body text, inputs and menu items (pt-text-md), the app's base size.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Descriptions, captions, badges and small buttons (pt-text-xs).

tokens.name: pt-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside badges, tight stacks.

tokens.name: pt-space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons and between chips; header group gap.

tokens.name: pt-space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls; input side padding. 8px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding; card padding. 12px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between widget sections and settings cards. 16px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-space-6
tokens.usage: Page-level section spacing. 24px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and small inputs.

tokens.name: pt-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: pt-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Widgets, cards, dialogs, tab panels.

tokens.name: pt-radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, header chips, switches, the search box.

tokens.name: pt-shadow
tokens.usage: Widgets, cards, popovers.

tokens.name: pt-shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts.

fontSize.note: The app's size steps as custom properties.

tokens.name: pt-text-xs
tokens.usage: Captions, badges, small buttons.

tokens.name: pt-text-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, labels.

tokens.name: pt-text-md
tokens.usage: Base body size. 13px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-text-lg
tokens.usage: Card titles.

tokens.name: pt-text-xl
tokens.usage: Page titles.

tokens.name: pt-text-2xl
tokens.usage: Greeting.

tokens.name: pt-control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, header chips, icon buttons (square). 32px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs. 26px when compact.

tokens.name: pt-widget-opacity
tokens.usage: Default opacity of widget glass over the backdrop; the theme can change it.

tokens.name: pt-glass-blur
tokens.usage: Blur radius of frosted glass, used only when the theme turns frosted glass on over a photo.
